data.title: Quick Apple Peek!
data.description: Practicing quick visual recognition of apple collections to build subitizing skills.

challenges.instruction: Take a quick peek! How many apples do you see right away?
challenges.hint: Try covering one apple with your finger and look at the other one!
challenges.narration: Look at these apples in a row. How many are there?

challenges.instruction: Quick! How many apples are hiding here?
challenges.hint: Look at the little cluster of apples together.
challenges.narration: Can you spot how many apples are in this group?

challenges.instruction: Can you see all the apples at a glance?
challenges.hint: They are spread out a little, but you can see them all at once!
challenges.narration: Take a fast look and tell me how many apples you see.

challenges.instruction: Spot the apples fast! How many are there?
challenges.hint: They are making a ring shape. Count them around the circle!
challenges.narration: Here are some apples in a circle. How many can you find?

challenges.instruction: How many apples are in this group?
challenges.hint: Try to see them as two pairs of apples.
challenges.narration: Look closely at this bunch of apples. How many are there?

challenges.instruction: Quick look! How many apples do you see?
challenges.hint: A whole hand full of apples! Can you see the total?
challenges.narration: Let's test your eyes with these apples. How many are there?

challenges.instruction: Last fast look! How many apples are on the board?
challenges.hint: Count them smoothly from one end to the other.
challenges.narration: Here is our final apple challenge. How many do you see?
